environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB SG to instance on 8080. No additional AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. Instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume. CloudWatch basic monitoring enabled but no custom log parsing or alerting on SQL errors.
